item.title: Prestige Assurance’s profit dips 76% to N741.3m in 2025 amid revenue growth
item.description: Prestige Assurance Plc has released its full-year 2025 unaudited financial results, indicating a sharp decline in profitability as profit before tax (PBT) fell by 76% to N741.3 million, down from N3.09 billion in 2024, despite posting double-digit growth in premiums and insurance revenue. item.title: FirstHoldco full year unaudited results decline 71% to N229 billion
item.description: FirstHoldco Plc has released its 2025 Unaudited Consolidated and Separate Financial Statements for the year ended December 31, 2025, reporting a pre-tax profit of N229.097 billion, reflecting a 71.18% decline compared to N796.461 billion in 2024.
